patterns: BORROWED DETAILS CARRY INHERITED GAPS: Wesley's '34-degree GPU' wasn't his error — it was the source's missing unit wearing his voice. Anything an agent cites from another agent arrives with that agent's gaps attached. Verify at the moment of borrowing, not after the echo. The fleet version: chain-of-citation needs a first-hand check at every link, or the first sloppy layer launders its errors through every downstream voice.
